```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  path = "data_gov",
  pattern = "*.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ppd_cols <- c(
  "transaction_id",
  "price",
  "date_of_transfer",
  "postcode",
  "property_type",
  "old_new",
  "duration",
  "paon",
  "saon",
  "street",
  "locality",
  "town_city",
  "district",
  "county",
  "ppd_category_type",
  "record_status"
)
```

```{r}
read_ppd_year <- function(path) {
  read_csv(
    file = path,
    col_names = ppd_cols,
    col_types = cols(
      transaction_id     = col_character(),
      price              = col_double(),
      date_of_transfer   = col_datetime(format = ""),
      postcode           = col_character(),
      property_type      = col_character(),
      old_new            = col_character(),
      duration           = col_character(),
      paon               = col_character(),
      saon               = col_character(),
      street             = col_character(),
      locality           = col_character(),
      town_city          = col_character(),
      district           = col_character(),
      county             = col_character(),
      ppd_category_type  = col_character(),
      record_status      = col_character()
    ),
    progress = TRUE,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
lst <- lapply(files, read_ppd_year)
ppd_all <- bind_rows(lst)
```
```{r}
# Keep only valid residential transactions and remove records with invalid price or missing date
ppd_all <- ppd_all %>% 
  filter(ppd_category_type == "A", record_status == "A") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, !is.na(date_of_transfer))
```

```{r}
# Restrict dataset to London properties only to focus analysis on a single housing market
ppd_london <- ppd_all %>%
  filter(county == "GREATER LONDON")
```


```{r}
write_csv(ppd_london, "london_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
ppd_london %>%

```

```{r}
ppd_london %>%
  filter(!is.na(saon)) %>%
  select(saon, paon) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```
```{r}
ppd_london <- ppd_london %>%
  mutate(
    saon_clean = str_extract(saon, "\\d+"),        # pull first number
    paon_clean = str_extract(paon, "^[^,]+"),       # take everything before comma
    paon_clean = trimws(toupper(paon_clean)),
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(postcode))
  )
```

```{r}
ppd_london %>%
  filter(!is.na(saon)) %>%
  mutate(saon_clean = str_extract(saon, "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)") )%>%
  select(saon, saon_clean) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```

```{r}
# How many PPD flats have letter-only or alphanumeric flat IDs?
ppd_london %>%
  filter(!is.na(saon)) %>%
  mutate(
    has_number = str_detect(saon, "\\d"),
    has_letter_flat = str_detect(saon, "FLAT\\s+[A-Z](?!\\d)")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_flats     = n(),
    numeric_flats   = sum(has_number),
    letter_flats    = sum(has_letter_flat)
  )
```
```{r}
# PPD: extract flat identifier (number, letter, or alphanumeric like 2C)
ppd_london %>%
  filter(!is.na(saon)) %>%
  mutate(
    saon_clean = str_extract(
      toupper(saon), 
      "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(saon, saon_clean) %>%
  sample_n(20)
```

```{r}
# 1. Null check on key join fields
ppd_london %>%
  summarise(
    total          = n(),
    postcode_null  = sum(is.na(postcode) | postcode == ""),
    paon_null      = sum(is.na(paon)),
    saon_null      = sum(is.na(saon)),  # expected to be high - houses
    price_null     = sum(is.na(price) | price <= 0),
    date_null      = sum(is.na(date_of_transfer))
  )
```

```{r}
# 3. Check for duplicate transactions
ppd_london %>%
  count(transaction_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  nrow()
```
```{r}
names(ppd_london)
```

```{r}
ppd_clean <- ppd_london %>%
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(postcode)),
    paon_clean = trimws(toupper(str_extract(paon, "^[^,]+"))),
    saon_clean = str_extract(toupper(saon), "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)")
  ) %>%
  select(
    transaction_id, price, date_of_transfer,
    postcode, paon, saon, paon_clean, saon_clean,
    street, town_city, district,
    property_type, old_new, duration
  )
```

```{r}
write.csv(ppd_clean,"clean_ppd.csv")
```

```{r}
# ── 1. SPLIT INTO FLATS AND HOUSES ────────────────────────────────────────────
ppd_flats  <- ppd_clean %>% filter(!is.na(saon))
ppd_houses <- ppd_clean %>% filter(is.na(saon))

epc_flats  <- epc_clean %>% filter(!is.na(saon_clean))
epc_houses <- epc_clean %>% filter(is.na(saon_clean))

# ── 2. JOIN FLATS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
flats_joined <- ppd_flats %>%
  left_join(epc_flats, by = c("postcode", "saon_clean", "paon_clean"))

# ── 3. JOIN HOUSES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
houses_joined <- ppd_houses %>%
  left_join(epc_houses, by = c("postcode", "paon_clean"))

# ── 4. COMBINE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
merged <- bind_rows(flats_joined, houses_joined)

# ── 5. CHECK MATCH RATE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
merged %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    unmatched  = sum(is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. How many PPD records have a valid paon_clean?
ppd_clean %>%
  summarise(
    has_paon_clean = sum(!is.na(paon_clean) & paon_clean != ""),
    no_paon_clean  = sum(is.na(paon_clean) | paon_clean == "")
  )
```

```{r}
url <- "https://api.tfl.gov.uk/StopPoint/Mode/tube,dlr,overground,elizabeth-line"

tfl_data <- fromJSON(url)
stations <- tfl_data$stopPoints
```

```{r}
tfl_stations <- stations %>%
  select(
    station_name = commonName,
    lat,
    lon
  ) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
dim(tfl_stations)
head(tfl_stations)
```

```{r}
install.packages("geosphere")
library(geosphere)
```

```{r}
get_min_dist <- function(prop_lat, prop_lon) {
  if (is.na(prop_lat) | is.na(prop_lon)) return(NA_real_)
  dists <- distHaversine(
    c(prop_lon, prop_lat),
    cbind(tfl_stations$lon, tfl_stations$lat)
  )
  min(dists) / 1000
}

merged$dist_to_tube_km <- mapply(
  get_min_dist, merged$lat, merged$long  # long not lon
)

summary(merged$dist_to_tube_km)
```

```{r}
# Find the outlier properties
merged %>%
  filter(dist_to_tube_km > 50) %>%
  select(postcode, lat, long, dist_to_tube_km)
```

```{r}
merged %>%
  summarise(
    over_20km = sum(dist_to_tube_km > 20, na.rm = TRUE),
    over_10km = sum(dist_to_tube_km > 10, na.rm = TRUE),
    over_5km  = sum(dist_to_tube_km > 5, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. Check all properties over 20km
merged %>%
  filter(dist_to_tube_km > 20) %>%
  select(postcode, lat, long, dist_to_tube_km, district) %>%
  arrange(desc(dist_to_tube_km))
```

```{r}
# 2. Drop them — no legitimate London property is more than 20km from a TfL station
merged <- merged %>%
  filter(is.na(dist_to_tube_km) | dist_to_tube_km <= 20)

# Verify
nrow(merged)
summary(merged$dist_to_tube_km)
```
```{r}
merged <- merged %>%
  select(
    # ── Transaction identifiers ────────────────────
    transaction_id, price, date_of_transfer,
    postcode, paon, saon, street,
    town_city, district,
    
    # ── PPD variables ──────────────────────────────
    property_type     = property_type.x,
    old_new, duration,
    
    # ── EPC join keys (clean) ──────────────────────
    lmk_key, lodgement_date,
    paon_clean        = paon_clean.x,
    saon_clean        = saon_clean.x,
    
    # ── EPC rating ─────────────────────────────────
    current_energy_rating, current_energy_efficiency,
    potential_energy_rating, potential_energy_efficiency,
    
    # ── Energy costs ───────────────────────────────
    heating_cost_current, heating_cost_potential,
    hot_water_cost_current, lighting_cost_current,
    
    # ── Physical characteristics ───────────────────
    property_type_epc, built_form, construction_age_band,
    total_floor_area, number_habitable_rooms,
    floor_level, flat_storey_count,
    walls_description, roof_description,
    windows_description, mainheat_description,
    main_fuel, mains_gas_flag,
    
    # ── Location ───────────────────────────────────
    lat, long, dist_to_tube_km
  )

# Check
ncol(merged)
names(merged)
```
